completenessAmendments.basis: Amphistaff canonicalPlayerText (three forms, spear wielded/thrown, whip reach 2 + Pin/Trip, venom spit 10 squares once/24h); damage/qualities cloned from certified Quarterstaff, Spear and Electropole-thrown range
Atlatl canonicalPlayerText (hurls energy balls; usable in melee); payload values copied from weapon-energy-ball; range from the certified simple-weapons range template (not Accurate)

Cesta canonicalPlayerText (hurls energy balls; usable in melee); payload values copied from weapon-energy-ball; range from the certified simple-weapons range template (Accurate per the Energy Ball cesta rule)

Shock Stick canonicalPlayerText (can be mounted as a rifle bayonet; wielder proficient with that rifle takes no nonproficiency penalty) — no second attack profile; proficiency waiver stays in operation.bayonetMount
